svg.title: The reply to a discussion
svg.desc: Someone other than the maintainer or a bot opens a discussion or comments on one. A discussion of the maintainer, and one whose answer was chosen, end there. Otherwise the pager shows it in its topic and asks the control repository for a draft at once, which Claude writes in the maintainer's voice. The draft comes with Send, Edit and Ignore. Send posts exactly that draft as the pager's app, in the thread of the comment that it answers, or on the discussion itself. A new comment of someone else makes itself the message to answer, with a new draft, in the same topic, while a text that the maintainer wrote themselves stays the draft. When the maintainer replies on GitHub itself, an answer is marked, or the discussion is closed, the thing is done: its buttons go, and its topic gets a check mark.
